view.title: Discarded Reliquary
view.text: A traveler's pack lies split open at the trail's edge, its owner nowhere to be found. Among the ruined provisions, a single card sits face-down, deliberately placed — as though left as a warning, not a gift.

choices.label: Take it with you (gain a Guilt curse; the pack has 45 cinders)
choices.resultText: You pick it up before you can think better of it. It settles into your deck like it was always there.

choices.label: Burn the pack (gain 25 cinders; leave the card)
choices.resultText: The provisions catch fast. The face-down card curls to ash before you can read it.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You step around the pack and do not look back.

outcome.resultText: You pick it up before you can think better of it. It settles into your deck like it was always there.

view.title: Bloodstained Altar
view.text: An altar of dark stone, its channels worn smooth by use. The instructions are carved plainly: the stone sharpens what is given to it, and it keeps a portion.

choices.label: Offer your blood (upgrade 2 random cards, lose 8% max HP)
choices.resultText: The channels drink. Two of your cards come back keener than any smith could make them.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: The altar does not care. It has waited longer than you.

outcome.resultText: The channels drink. Two of your cards come back keener than any smith could make them.

view.title: The Second Cairn
view.text:
Beside the road stands a second cairn. Its swords have fallen into the mud; no names are carved on its stones.

The keeper is not here. The road continues beyond it, and you cannot tell which way the keeper went.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You leave the swords fallen and follow the road. The cairn keeps its silence.

outcome.resultText: You leave the swords fallen and follow the road. The cairn keeps its silence.

view.title: Seat of Faded Emberlight
view.text: A guiding ember once pooled here, now guttering to a thread of gold. It has just enough left to give — a mending, or a sharpening — but not both, and not for long.

choices.label: Warm yourself (heal 18% max HP)
choices.resultText: The last of the light soaks into you. When it fades, the ground is only ground.

choices.label: Temper a blade (upgrade a random card, lose 6% max HP)
choices.resultText: You hold a card to the dying ember until it takes the edge. It costs you something to keep the flame that long.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You let the ember fade unspent. Some kindnesses are not yours to take.

outcome.resultText: The last of the light soaks into you. When it fades, the ground is only ground.

view.title: Warden's Altar
view.text: An altar carved with a face too many-eyed to be a saint. A voice — or something like one — offers to lend you its strength, if you will let it watch through your eyes for the rest of the road.

choices.label: Accept its gaze (gain a random relic; take a Guilt curse)
choices.resultText: The eyes close over yours like a second lid. You do not feel them leave.

choices.label: Shatter the altar (fight what wakes, gain 70 cinders)
choices.resultText: The stone face cracks down the middle. What answers the noise is not stone at all.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: The many eyes stay open behind you, patient as ever.

outcome.resultText: The eyes close over yours like a second lid. You do not feel them leave.

view.title: The Keeper of the Nameless
view.text:
A figure in grave-clothes waits at a fork in the road, a lantern of cinder-light held low.

It knows the cairn of broken swords. It knows what you did there. It has been walking since.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: The keeper does not follow. It only needed to be seen.

outcome.resultText: The keeper does not follow. It only needed to be seen.

view.title: Sleeping Smith
view.text: A smith slumps over his anvil, hammer still loose in one hand. His forge is cold, but the blade laid across it hums like it remembers heat. He does not stir when you approach.

choices.label: Take the blade (upgrade a random card)
choices.resultText: The hum quiets the moment it leaves the anvil, as if it was only ever waiting for a hand.

choices.label: Wake him (pay 30 cinders, heal 12% max HP)
choices.resultText: He blinks awake just long enough to press a cold coin into your palm, and something in you settles.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You let him sleep. The blade goes on humming behind you.

outcome.resultText: He blinks awake just long enough to press a cold coin into your palm, and something in you settles.
